title: Built a proper loop to fix lookahead bias, strategy errors
author: Awkward_Weather5721
selftext:
Hey guys, 

I dont wanna promote my project here, but i have seen many people here complaining about claude code and codex, giving fake positives and backtesting looks really good, but actually it fails.

so, i have crerated a harness just for this, it is a fork of opencode where basically i give the main agent to call Crucible (my backtestor) and the main thing is the agent can never touch the backtesting engine. It includes, walkforwards folds, alpha decay and all the things needed to conclude the strategy should work

Check it out: [https://github.com/finny-ai/finny](https://github.com/finny-ai/finny)  
Website: [finnyai.tech](http://finnyai.tech)
